obfuscation_indicators: large and unpredictable variations in demand
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides useful detail on segment exposure, acquisitions, debt capacity, covenant compliance, labor volatility, demand uncertainty, and integration-related quality issues. Risk tone is mildly negative because it highlights unpredictable demand, limited visibility, manufacturing disruption, customer-relationship rebuilding, and increased leverage, although management presents these issues as actively manageable.
